ai.summary: Hiccups are involuntary diaphragmatic contractions that can be benign or signal serious pathology. In low‑resource hospitals, focus on common infectious and metabolic causes, quick bedside assessment, and pragmatic management.

b: History of sudden onset, brief, repetitive sound

sections.p: Hiccups are brief, involuntary inspiratory spasms of the diaphragm and intercostal muscles, producing a characteristic sound. Diagnosis is clinical; no imaging is required for a simple episode.

Most episodes are self‑limited. Persistent hiccups >48 h are considered chronic and warrant investigation. No formal staging system exists, but duration and impact on nutrition/respiration guide urgency.
